lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular spots posterior to the gill slits, with centroid diameters appearing larger and more widely spaced along the mid-lateral line compared to the cephalic region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal carinae to form a coordinate-like grid where the primary circular blobs are centered within the rectangular nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance superior edges and shadowed inferior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in spot morphology from large, grid-aligned blobs on the lateral flank to a high-density stochastic distribution of minute punctate spots on the cephalic region.
